cands.name: Anne Gerwig
cands.bio: Republican state representative for HD 93 since 2024. Former Wellington Village Council member (2010-2016) and Mayor of Wellington (2016-2024). Worked in client communications at her husband's engineering firm.
cands.local_ties: Wellington; served on the Wellington council and as mayor for 14 years (Florida Politics, Oct 2026).

record.text: Passed bills in 2026 on teacher certification reinstatement, clinical laboratory personnel licensing and home-based child care enrollment in Palm Beach County; in 2025 passed a bill letting school districts opt out of the statewide later school start-time requirement and a bill creating an annual Fentanyl Awareness and Education Day.
Won the seat in 2024 by 354 votes after a mandatory recount against then-Rep. Katherine Waldron.

money_notes.text: Q4 2025 report: raised more than $87,000, including a $50,000 self-loan; $1,000 gifts from firms and committees including Becker & Poliakoff, lobbyist Ron Book's firm, Florida Crystals subsidiary American Exports, Florida Association of Nurse Anesthesiologists, Florida Surveying and Mapping PAC, Comcast and companies tied to JM Family Automotive; about $98,000 on hand entering 2026.

controversies.text: Per Wikipedia: faced 12 election-code counts over her 2014 council campaign finances (2017 probe) and was cleared.

Per Wikipedia: in 2023 as Wellington mayor she voted for the first reading of a plan to remove equestrian-preserve land for luxury housing (Bellissimo project); a recall effort followed but her term ended before it took effect.

endorsements.text: South Florida Sun-Sentinel editorial board; Florida Chamber of Commerce; Associated Industries of Florida; Florida Medical Association; Palm Beach County Classroom Teachers Association; firefighter and police organizations; BizPAC of Palm Beach County; The Hispanic Vote PAC.
